verdict.rationale: Lago is event-driven: it emits webhooks with signatures, retries, and event inspection (lago-docs-7, lago-docs-21, lago-docs-22, lago-docs-8), so users can trigger actions in their own systems. It also runs built-in automations such as plan-based invoice generation (lago-docs-20) and a Dunning Agent that chases overdue invoices (lago-docs-25, lago-docs-10). However, these are fixed product behaviors or outbound hooks, not user-defined rules, so the actual rule logic has to live in external tooling. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable rule/trigger engine (condition → action) inside Lago, documentation of custom automation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
